title: Second opinion — written, honest, no-obligation
subtitle: You already have a diagnosis from another dentist. Before any irreversible step, get a written review with your actual options.

sections.heading: Why get a second opinion
sections.body: A second opinion can confirm a diagnosis, change the treatment, or catch options the first provider missed. For crowns, implants, root canals, extractions, or full-mouth plans, a fresh professional review is one of the lowest-risk, highest-value decisions you can make.

sections.heading: What you receive
items: Clinical review of your existing studies and records.
Honest written report: what is actually needed, what can be avoided.
Alternative options with timelines and reference pricing.
No obligation to continue treatment here.

sections.heading: What to bring
items: Any clinical records and notes from the first provider.

sections.heading: Timing and format
items: Delivered as a written document you can keep or share.
Includes findings, options, recommendations, and referenced pricing.

sections.heading: When a second opinion matters most
items: A major procedure was recommended after only a brief exam.
You feel the plan skipped alternatives or timelines.
You want a Spanish/English review before committing.
You had a bad experience and want an independent check.
The proposed treatment feels rushed or pressure-heavy.

pricing_ref: Gs 450,000 — Gs 600,000 with full treatment plan
